results.excerpt: decodeUrl(java.util.BitSet,byte[]): decodeUrl public static final byte[] decodeUrl(java.util.BitSet urlsafe, byte[] bytes) throws DecoderException Decodes an array of bytes using the safe set supplied to encodeUrl(BitSet, byte[]). Otherwise, a plus sign becomes a space only if space is marked safe. A null bitset selects the default www-form-urlencoded safe set, giving the same behavior as decodeUrl(byte[]).
